parsed.name: 树莓派硬件SPI接口
parsed.description: 树莓派板载的硬件 SPI 总线接口，通过 GPIO 排针与支持 SPI 的外设进行同步串行通信，常用于实验室原型开发、传感器与 ADC/DAC 连接，以及小型仪器控制与数据采集。
parsed.description_en: The onboard hardware SPI bus interface of a Raspberry Pi, exposed through the GPIO header for synchronous serial communication with SPI peripherals. It is commonly used in labs for prototyping, connecting sensors and ADCs/DACs, and for small instrument control and data acquisition.
